answer: One enforceable rule: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. An identity earns only when its sable recurs, its sparrow survives audit, and a vault from an unlinked peer confirms it.
